{"hypotheses":[{"nl":"Place 1 at the midpoint (floor average) of the two nonzero cells.","code":"def transform(grid):

    (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=pts[0],pts[1]
    r=(r1+r2)//2; c=(c1+c2)//2
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    out[r][c]=1
    return out"},{"nl":"Place 1 at the midpoint (ceil average) of the two nonzero cells.","code":"def transform(grid):
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=0]
    if len(pts)<2: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=pts[0],pts[1]
    r=(r1+r2+1)//2; c=(c1+c2+1)//2
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    out[r][c]=1
    return out"},{"nl":"Place 1 at the center of the whole grid, regardless of nonzero cells.","code":"def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    R=len(grid); C=len(grid[0])
    out[R//2][C//2]=1
    return out"},{"nl":"Place 1 at the center of the bounding box of all nonzero cells (floor).","code":"def transform(grid):

    r=(min(rs)+max(rs))//2; c=(min(cs)+max(cs))//2
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    out[r][c]=1
    return out"},{"nl":"Place 1 at the center of the bounding box of all nonzero cells (ceil).","code":"def transform(grid):

    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    out[r][c]=1
